decisions.reason: Replacing referenced photos with more attractive alternatives does not change the product description, target customers, messaging emphasis, or marketing purpose.
The photo-selection change does not alter inclusion or sourcing of the embedded product video.
The request to replace referenced photos does not necessarily modify or supersede the separate obligation to customize the reference design using the client's product pictures.
Changing photo selection has no effect on the landing page's shareable-link delivery or access behavior.
